item.title: Ceuta an 'inalienable' part of Spain, king says on key visit
item.description: King Felipe VI on Tuesday said Ceuta and Melilla were "an inalienable part" of Spain as he made a landmark visit to the north African territories claimed by neighbouring Morocco. "Ceuta and Melilla are an inalienable part of the political and national reality that is Spain. The sovereignty and territorial integrity of our country are not negotiable," Felipe said. FRANCE 24's Sarah Morris reports from Madrid. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Shreveport's former Libbey Glass plant faces demolition, with 95% of materials set for recycling
item.description: Full-scale demolition of the former Libbey Glass plant in Shreveport is now underway and progressing. Environmental contaminants have been cleared over the 54-acre site, allowing for redevelopment opportunities. Demolition teams are set to dismantle the industrial silos that have dominated the skyline for decades. Local authorities expect increased truck traffic around Jewella Avenue until mid-2027 due to construction activities. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: EE.UU. se incauta de un petrolero con destino a Cuba acusado de contrabando
item.description: Estados Unidos ha interceptado , al menos, dos buques con combustible presuntamente destinado a Cuba y, por separado, se ha incautado de 90 cargamentos de biodiésel. El ministro cubano de Energía y Minas, Vicente de la O Levy, niega que el régimen cubano esté vinculado a las mercancías confiscadas y asegura que ninguna empresa estatal consiguió contratos para importar ese combustible. Los envíos sumaban más de 2,3 millones de litros y estaban valorados en unos 2,8 millones de dólares (2,5 millones de euros). Según las autoridades estadounidenses, los cargamentos tenían como destinataria a… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.
